messages:
emily.partners: :tada: Quick heads-up — AxiomEdge is live on the DigitalOcean Marketplace and our co-branded case study just went up. https://marketplace.digitalocean.com/apps/axiomedge (listing + 30% launch credit for first 60 days)
deploy-bot: Marketplace listing for AxiomEdge published by emily.partners at 2026-03-22T10:12:34Z
raj.sales: Amazing! Huge win for the Dedicated product — they chose a reserved pool + private VPC. Can we get a logo lockup for sales decks? :star-struck:
sam.prod: Nice. Note: they use SAML SSO and are testing our newest autoscale policy. Recommend we capture the rollout config in the case study (vm-sku, gpu-type, autoscale thresholds).
olivia.marketing: On it — I'll draft the blog and a short customer quote. Can @marta.support share a one-pager on onboarding and runbook we can link to?
marta.support: Will do. I'll attach the onboarding checklist and a 15-min troubleshooting guide by EOD.
emily.partners: FYI finance — this is a hybrid deal (marketplace usage + reserved commitment). @raj.sales, looping you for billing alignment.
raj.sales: Yep — pinging finance separately. Also capturing for Q2 renewals playbook. This could be a reference for other healthcare ISVs.
olivia.marketing: Draft headline options: "AxiomEdge scales clinical NLP with Redwood Dedicated" or "AxiomEdge reduces inference costs 48% with Redwood" — which do folks prefer?
sam.prod: First one highlights product fit, second hits metrics. Leaning to headline 2 if we can include the % with permission.
emily.partners: Good point. I'll ask them for permission to publish the metric. Meanwhile, marketing — plan a short case study + 90s video for the marketplace tile.
marta.support: Also note: their engineering lead asked for a quick runbook snippet for migrating KV cache when switching regions. I'll add that to the onboarding doc.
olivia.marketing: Nice. I'll drop a content plan in #eng-marketing and schedule a sync with AxiomEdge for a quote tomorrow.
raj.sales: Woot! :rocket: Great cross-team effort everyone.
emily.partners: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please react with :thumbsup: when your item is done so I can mark it in the launch tracker.
